title: Transferred model structure on associative algebras
statement:
Use the model-category and universe conventions of [lem-coef-model-infinity-derived-adjunction]. A combinatorial model category is complete, cocomplete and locally presentable with both weak factorization systems generated by sets, as defined in [lem-coef-combinatorial-localization-presentability]. Let $\mathcal M$ be such a category, equipped with an associative unital monoidal product $\odot$ with its associativity and unit isomorphisms, not assumed symmetric. Assume both $X\odot-$ and $-\odot X$ have right adjoints for every $X$ (biclosedness), the tensor unit $\mathbf1$ is cofibrant, and the pushout product of two cofibrations is a cofibration, trivial if either factor is trivial. Here the pushout product of $a:A\to B$ and $b:C\to D$ is $(B\odot C)\amalg_{A\odot C}(A\odot D)\to B\odot D$. Assume the following nonsymmetric monoid axiom: the class generated under pushouts, small transfinite compositions and retracts by all finite iterated pushout products $a_1\mathbin\square\cdots\mathbin\square a_n$, where each $a_i$ is either a trivial cofibration or $0\to X_i$ for an arbitrary object $X_i$, and at least one is a trivial cofibration, consists of weak equivalences. Transfinite composition means the composite of an ordinal-indexed sequence continuous at every limit ordinal. A strict associative unital algebra is an object $A$ with maps $A\odot A\to A$ and $\mathbf1\to A$ satisfying the associativity and two unit identities using the monoidal constraints; its morphisms preserve these maps. Write $\operatorname{Alg}(\mathcal M)$ for their category and $U$ for the forgetful functor.

There is a combinatorial model structure on $\operatorname{Alg}(\mathcal M)$ whose fibrations and weak equivalences are exactly the maps sent by $U$ to fibrations and weak equivalences of $\mathcal M$. The free algebra functor $T$, left adjoint to $U$, and $U$ form a Quillen adjunction, meaning that $T$ preserves cofibrations and trivial cofibrations; $T(X)=\coprod_{n\geq0}X^{\odot n}$ with $X^{\odot0}=\mathbf1$, multiplication concatenating the factors and unit the zeroth summand. For any generating cofibrations $I$ and generating trivial cofibrations $J$ of $\mathcal M$, $T(I)$ and $T(J)$ generate the two lifting systems in the algebra category. The functor $U$ sends cofibrant algebras to cofibrant objects of $\mathcal M$.

source.place: Definitions 3.2 and 3.6; Corollaries 3.14 and 3.15. The nonsymmetric monoid axiom is Muro, Homotopy theory of nonsymmetric operads, Definition 9.1 (arbitrary auxiliary objects); the printed cofibrancy restriction in Haugseng Definition 3.11 is not used. See Source error in report.
